title: Synthesis and Crystal Structure of a Trinuclear Aminobis(phenolate) Ytterbium Hydroxide Complex

material_class.structural_family: trinuclear Yb3(μ-OH)3(μ3-H2O) aminobis(phenolate) hydroxide with a chair six-membered Yb–OH ring

synthesis.procedure: To a THF solution (about 30 mL) of (THF)LYb(SC6H4-p-CH3) (1.720 g, 1.90 mmol) was added a THF solution (about 10 mL) of water (0.08 mL, 4.44 mmol). The mixture turned slightly turbid, was stirred for 1 h, and then centrifuged. The clear solution was charged into a glass tube and evaporated naturally in air at room temperature. Colorless crystals of 1·3THF·4H2O formed in several days.
synthesis.time: stirred 1 h; crystals in several days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: centrifugation then natural evaporation in a glass tube in air
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: mixture centrifuged; clear solution evaporated naturally in air at room temperature to give colorless crystals of 1·3THF·4H2O

source_locations.location: Experimental elemental analysis C117H211N6O20Yb3; abstract formula [(H2O)LYb(μ-OH)]3(μ3-H2O)
